Hank: Hey finance, ran into a weird FX mismatch on a Tokyo hotel charge. Corp card shows 48,320 JPY posted on 2024-08-02 but vendor invoice says 45,000 JPY. Bank posted the higher USD equivalent.
Lina: Did the bank apply a DCC or was there a card processor rounding? Can you upload the card line and invoice?
Hank: Uploaded both. Descriptor shows DYN-CURR CONV. Hotel support says they charged in JPY but the checkout offered 'pay in USD' and guest selected it by mistake.
Jorge: If cardholder selected DCC, our policy says reimburse up to vendor invoice and flag the excess for employee repayment unless manager approves exception. Do we have manager signoff?
Maya: Manager (Priya) approved absorbing 50% of the 3,320 JPY excess as a one-time customer event oversight. Please record as exception EXC-DCC-2024-08-02.
expense-bot: Flag: DCC event recorded. Suggested GL entries: DR Lodging 45,000 JPY / DR Travel Misc 1,660 JPY / DR Employee Recovery 1,660 JPY / CR Card Payable 48,320 JPY.
Lina: Thanks, I'll post the journal and add Concur note: "Manager approved one-time 50% absorption EXC-DCC-2024-08-02". Also can we add a line to corp-card policy: "Avoid DCC prompts; pay in vendor currency when possible."
Hank: Will remind traveling team. Closing once GL posted.
Jorge: GL posted: REF GL-TRV-2024-08-DCC1. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
